extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the Web Store and chrome://extensions

extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Web Store and chrome://extensions
extensionDescription.message: Interactive map overlay for nehnutelnosti.sk — addresses from listings are auto-geocoded onto OpenStreetMap and shown as markers with price, area or title. Filters by price and area, favorites, local cache.

clearCache.description: Button that clears the geocoding cache

clearing.description: Status while the cache is being cleared

cleared.description: Status after the cache has been cleared

geocodingBy.description: Footer credit for the geocoding service

expand.description: Tooltip for the floating button that expands the overlay

maximize.description: Tooltip for the button that grows the overlay to full width and 50% height

restore.description: Tooltip for the button that returns the overlay from maximized to normal size

collapse.description: Tooltip for the button that collapses the overlay into the floating button

favoriteOn.description: Label for a listing already marked as favorite

favoriteOff.description: Label for a listing not yet marked as favorite

showOnPage.description: Button that scrolls the listing into view on the host page

areaRange.description: Label for the dual-handle area range slider

markerLabelSetting.description: Label for the dropdown in Settings that picks the marker label type

markerLabelToggle.description: Tooltip for the header button that cycles the marker label type

markerLabelNone.description: Option: render markers as plain dots without a label

markerLabelPrice.description: Option: render the listing price as the marker label

markerLabelTitle.description: Option: render the listing title as the marker label

markerLabelArea.description: Option: render the listing area in m² as the marker label

geocodedOf.description: Footer counter — $1 = geocoded count, $2 = total addressable listings

geocodingInProgress.description: Tooltip for the pulsing indicator — $1 = number of addresses pending geocoding

displayErrorInfo.description: Heading on the error fallback screen

displayErrorDescription.description: Body text on the error fallback screen

displayErrorDetailsInfo.description: Label preceding the technical error details

displayErrorReset.description: Button that retries after an error
